attachment.description: An image sent beside the payload with --attach, by its name: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG.

region.description: A rectangle on an image, as fractions of its width and height from the top left: 0 to 1.

notes.description: Markdown: what this round is, and what to look at.

pairs.description: Each thing that changed, as a before and an after image of the same view.

name.description: What the images show, e.g. Pricing page, desktop.

after.description: The image as it is now. New comments are placed on this one.

pixel_ratio.description: How many image pixels make one screen pixel, e.g. 2 for a retina screenshot, so the images show at their real size. Default 1.

summary.description: Markdown: what changed between the two.

requests.description: What this revision claims to address: the requests from the round before, each one checked by the reviewer.

id.description: Keep the same id across rounds, so the reviewer sees what they said last time.

text.description: What was asked, in the reviewer's words where you have them.

region.description: Where it was asked, on the before image.

after_region.description: Where the change for it is, on the after image. Default: the same place as region.

claim.description: What you changed to address it.
